Or maybe just throw it in the recycling – every future issue could be written in German anyway if Burnham gets his way

It’s the “choice of a lifetime”. The stakes have never been higher. Do you waste 15 minutes of your life reading the second issue of the Reformer, the official monthly newspaper of Reform, every word of which has been written by me, Nigel Farage?

Or do you just throw it straight into the recycling bin?
